title: The Game Awards Just Revealed Who Plays Lucia in GTA 6 🎭 #Shorts
description:
Manni L. Perez was nominated for Best Performance at The Game Awards 2026 for Grand Theft Auto VI, announced on November 17, 2026. Rockstar has never published a cast list, so the nomination is the clearest link yet between Perez and Lucia Caminos. GTA 6 received eight nominations, including Game of the Year. Jason's actor is still not officially confirmed. Winners will be revealed on December 10 at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles.

Sources: The Game Awards 2026 nominees (Nov 17, 2026), ComicBook.com, Game Rant, VICE. Images: official Rockstar Games trailers.

Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
